text:
alex: RFC follow-up: per-model flagging + fallback kernels. need a concise plan for gating, telemetry, and rollout API. quick sync?

priya: yep. main asks: how to express per-model enablement, default fallbacks, and canary sampling. also how to avoid silent quality regressions.

dylan: proposal in RFC had `kernel_policy` on model config. suggest variant: separate `runtime.rollout` object so we can version it without changing model id.

morgan: agree. also need runtime to emit `kernel_selection_event` with reason, chosen_kernel, fallback_reason, and selection_path for downstream analysis :eyes:

alex: sketch of config i'm proposing:
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-large",
  "runtime": {
    "rollout": {
      "enabled": true,
      "canary_percent": 5,
      "primary_kernel": "gpt-large-fp16",
      "fallback_kernels": ["gpt-large-int8", "gpt-large-compat"],
      "selectors": [{"type": "tenant", "match": "tenant:corp-.*", "canary_percent": 0}]
    }
  }
}
```

priya: question: should per-tenant override be allowed? enterprise customers will want control and auditability.

dylan: yes — include `overrides` with selector precedence. runtime should resolve most-specific selector first.

runtime-bot: deploy-bot: rollout config applied to staging (gpt-large): canary=10% -> kernel 'gpt-large-int8' :rocket:

morgan: guardrails we need: min_tokens_observed, divergence_threshold (on eval promptset), error_rate_limit, and automatic rollback if thresholds exceeded.

alex: ops question: how do we route to fallback kernel on kernel crash? current flow retries same container. we should detect kernel-level errors (codes: KERNEL_OOM, KERNEL_CRASH, INVALID_OUTPUT) and select next compatible kernel.

priya: also prefer functional-equivalent fallbacks (same architecture/precision family) to avoid semantic drift. Only use very different kernels as last resort.

dylan: UI vs config-as-code: prefer code-first (model config + infra rollout manifests) but expose Console for non-dev ops. must include audit logs for every changed selector.

morgan: action items: 1) telemetry spec for `kernel_selection_event` + metrics; 2) extend model config schema w/ `runtime.rollout`; 3) selector API + precedence rules; 4) e2e test harness to measure divergence on canary traffic.

alex: i'll draft the addendum to the RFC and split into three PRs (schema, metrics, runtime). owners: @dylan (schema), @morgan (telemetry/runtime), @priya (console/audit). target: staging next week, prod canary in ~2 weeks :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-bot: FYI — last rollback (see thread 1769001111) was triggered by KERNEL_OOM on quantized path; let's ensure the rollback trigger is based on both error + quality signals.

priya: thanks — sending quick follow-up with example eval prompts and thresholds.

alex: great. will tag folks in the RFC PR. closing sync here unless something urgent pops up.
